sql: SELECT record_date, tot_pub_debt_out_amt FROM econ.federal_debt ORDER BY record_date DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT candidate_name, popular_votes, state_total_votes FROM officials.presidential_election_results WHERE state_name='Mississippi' ORDER BY popular_votes DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT "year", raw_wage_text FROM fiscal.state_minimum_wage_history WHERE jurisdiction_type='FEDERAL' AND "year" BETWEEN 2006 AND 2024 ORDER BY "year"
